items.title: Minor "Ram" Hall Interview, 1958-09-02
items.q: Well it could be, but we always called him Zeb or Zeb.

ctx.x: So one time, my brother couldn't get off. Well, excuse me, do you know Zeb's real name, his last name? No, all I knew was he's Zeb. No, I never could think of his last name, Clarence Platt. I believe Professor Minetta, who was here last night, said something like L-E-N-O-I-R.

Well it could be, but we always called him Zeb or Zeb. So he couldn't make the trip. And in the meantime, I still was wearing short pants. So my brother asked me, he said, do you think if I let you go to my place, could you make it? He said, well, I don't know, I'll try. So I had to borrow a pair of long pants to put on. So I went in his place, the fellow, his boy was, he played clarinet and guitar. His first name was Koyko. Oh yes. Yeah. He talked about the California years. Yeah, he died, you know. So I went in…
Well do you remember, by the way, when Tubby was born, what year?
